name: NURS 3220
title: Clinical Science for Sub-Acute and Chronically Ill Adults
description: Critical examination of concepts of pharmacology, microbiology, nutrition and pathophysiology as they relate to nursing care of adults with sub-acute and chronic health problems and their families. May be repeated for a total of 3 credits.
requirement_description: To enroll in this course, a student must have earned a "C" or better in NURS 1130, 1131, 3100, 3110, and 3120; open only to Nursing majors.
